note: JOG races in the FirstShift Route area, from the JOG 2027 programme (dates published; the 2027 Notice of Race is due 1 December 2026). JOG publishes courses in its sailing instructions, which are not yet in hand: coastal races are set on the day, most passage races show start and finish only, and two show the 2025 course from race reports. Positions marked approximate are approximate charted positions of the named places, for routing only: check the sailing instructions. Distances are JOG's 2026 figures from the 2026 Notice of Race. Solent mark positions are from JOG's Solent race mark list (23 February 2026). JOG publishes each race's sailing instructions on its website at least seven days before the start (Notice of Race 3.1).
